awards.label: {count, plural, one {# award} other {# awards}} for {year}
awards.sub: One winner each. Pick a creator in every award you care about; you do not have to fill in all of them.
awards.empty: The awards of this edition have not been added yet.

signin.title: Sign in
signin.body: Use your account, or make one. Every vote belongs to an account, so each person counts once.

uid.title: Link your Free Fire UID
uid.body: Add your Free Fire UID once. One UID, one account: a UID can only be linked to a single account.

pick.title: Pick your creators
pick.body: One pick per award. Change it as often as you like until voting closes. Share a nominee's page to bring their fans in.

steps.title: From list to stage
steps.sub: Five steps from the first list to the trophy. Garena signs off twice, and nothing goes public before Garena has seen it.

s1.title: Categories and lists
s1.body: {count, plural, one {One award} other {# awards}}, each with a list of creators and every account link.

s2.title: Garena checks
s2.body: Garena reviews the accounts and approves the nominees: add, remove or swap names.

s3.title: Community vote
s3.body: You vote here, signed in, once per account.

s4.title: The count
s4.body: The numbers, your votes and a blind panel are combined. Garena confirms each winner.

s5.title: The night
s5.body: Winners revealed live at Detty Royale Showdown, the trophy handed over on stage.

trophy.title: The trophy
trophy.sub: What the winners lift on stage. Scroll to turn it.

c1.title: Gold Africa
c1.body: The real outline, 28 cm tall and 2.5 cm thick, between two gold horns, with each award's own emblem raised on it.

c2.title: Black marble base
c2.body: On a gold plinth. About 52 cm tall in all.

trophy.made: {count, plural, one {# made, one per award} other {# made, one per award}}
trophy.everyone: Every nominee also gets a plaque and a certificate.

decided.title: How a winner is decided
decided.sub: Three parts, then Garena's word. Ties go to the panel, then the numbers.

numbers.title: The numbers
numbers.body: What the audience does on each creator's posts, counted per view so size alone does not win.

votes.title: Your votes
votes.body: The community vote on this page.

panel.title: The panel
panel.body: Five judges who never know each other. Garena can name seats.

then.title: Then Garena
then.body: Every winner goes to Garena before the night: confirm, or overrule with a reason that is recorded. Nothing is announced before it.

night.title: The night
night.sub: The winners are revealed live at Detty Royale Showdown. Each nominee's film plays on the big screen just before their award is named.

who.a: Anyone with an account. Making an account is free.

whoUid.a: Anyone with an account and a Free Fire UID linked to it. Making an account is free.

howMany.q: How many votes do I get?
howMany.a: One pick in each award. Each account has one ballot.

change.a: Yes, as often as you like until voting closes. Only your last pick counts.

winning.q: Can I see who is winning?
winning.a: No. This page does not show vote counts, so an early lead does not decide the rest of the vote.

whyUid.q: Why do you need my Free Fire UID?
whyUid.a: So one player counts once. Your UID is never shown on the page.
